summary: Suppress near-duplicate alert creation for active alerts with same title/severity inside a configurable time window.
scope_anchors: repository query for active title+severity duplicate within cutoff
constraints: Duplicate match requires same title case-insensitively and same severity.
Only active prior alerts are eligible for suppression.
Prior matching alert must be within configured window minutes from current UTC time.
Suppressed duplicate returns 200 OK and includes header X-Duplicate-Suppressed: true.
New alert creation remains 201 Created with CreatedAtRoute behavior.
Suppression window value must come from appsettings.json (no hardcoded constant).
coverage_goals: Controller create endpoint returns 200 + suppression header for duplicate suppression and 201 for new create.
Service create flow enforces title/severity/active/window suppression conditions accurately.
Repository duplicate lookup honors case-insensitive title and window boundary conditions.
